top_items.summary: More than 120 people in the Tennessee city were detained in one of the largest single-day ICE raids in the US in 2026 The date 1 September, or 9/01 Day, is a festive day for Memphians. The date mirrors the city’s 901 area code, and gives residents a reason to come together to celebrate the city and the people who love it. When 9/01 Day falls on a weekday, as it did this year, the celebration starts the weekend prior, extending the festivities. Groups across the city hosted celebrations featuring food vendors, DJs, musicians and members of the Memphis Grizzlies , the local NBA team, while dozens of local businesses offered $9.01-themed specials. But for the families of 121 people, this past 1 September will be remembered for a different reason – just days prior, US Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) officers detained their friends and relatives, conducting one of the largest single-day raids in the country this year, and the largest known one in Memphis .
